headline: Valve open-sources Steam Machine e-ink screen for DIY
summary: Valve releases Inkterface under MIT license
details: Valve has open-sourced the e-ink screen for the Steam Machine, allowing anyone to create their own. The project, called 'Inkterface', is available on GitLab under the MIT license.
The Inkterface requires several components to build, which are detailed on the GitLab page. Valve has also provided a video showing the assembly process.
Other vendors, such as JSAUX, have teased pre-built versions of the Inkterface. The project may attract other accessory brands to create their own versions.
caption:
Can you build your own Steam Machine e-ink screen?

Valve has open-sourced the e-ink screen for the Steam Machine, allowing anyone to create their own. The project, called 'Inkterface', is available on GitLab under the MIT license.

The Inkterface requires several components to build, which are detailed on the GitLab page. Valve has also provided a video showing the assembly process.

Other vendors, such as JSAUX, have teased pre-built versions of the Inkterface. The project may attract other accessory brands to create their own versions.
